author: PopBase
text:
The Weeknd opens up about his career and what lies ahead for him in his recent GQ Hong Kong and GQ Singapore cover stories:

“I once caught a glimpse of what retirement looks like, but that wasn’t for me. What I’m doing now is a true privilege; no work can compare to it. Over the past year, I’ve been filled with gratitude. As long as I’m still okay, I’ll keep going. The Weeknd isn’t going anywhere.”
